subject: Scaffy (barkpark chore catalog)
what_it_shows: A real Scaffy round-trip in a throwaway barkpark worktree: list the served command catalog, run add-docs-card with three variables (3 files created/injected, closing asserts green, receipt written), then retract it with the same vars back to a byte-clean tree.
version_or_sha: barkpark commit c8856720573630a97fe5927f8b41cc04e01cc943, bp cli_version dev
how_produced: asciinema record --headless --window-size 100x30 -i 2 -c 'bash driver.sh demo-scaffy.cmds <detached worktree of barkpark@c885672>' scaffy-run-remove.cast — every command in the cast executed live; driver.sh only types them at readable speed

subject: bp CLI — bp paper view
what_it_shows: The same Bulldocs document rendered in the terminal: bp paper view welcome (fits one screen), then the 159-line deploy-with-barkpark product plan typeset live from the server with ANSI typography.
how_produced: asciinema record --headless --window-size 100x40 -i 2 -c 'bash driver.sh demo-paper.cmds' bp-paper-view.cast — the long paper is piped through awk sleep 0.05/line purely to slow the scroll; content is the live render

subject: bp tasks — the live portrait task board
what_it_shows: The live task board connected to a real ledger (4382 tasks): epics with active work pinned on top, j/k navigation, Enter descending into a task's full detail with acceptance criteria and evidence in the reader pane, esc back up, q to quit.
how_produced: tmux new-session -x 110 -y 42 running 'asciinema record --window-size 110x42 -i 2 -c "bp tasks"'; keys driven via tmux send-keys (j,j,j,Enter,Esc,G,g,q) against the live board

subject: Doey CLI

subject: Barkpark Studio — API-token sign-in

subject: Barkpark Studio — authenticated home
